static_export.notes: Native format; nothing is exported to itself.

cli_adapter.notes: Claude Code itself is the CLI that runs tasks; there is no separate external adapter because none is needed.

full_integration.notes: Task state, handoffs and reviews (agents/, tasks.mjs, reports.mjs, gate.mjs) are native to this framework.

static_export.notes: Generated by `node scripts/export-ide.mjs cursor`: rules, skills and hooks.json. Exported but never run inside Cursor; see docs/ide/smoke-test.md to verify and flip this to VERIFIED.

cli_adapter.notes: Cursor has no scriptable CLI this framework can drive to run a task headlessly.

full_integration.notes: No task-state, handoff or review wiring exists for Cursor.

static_export.notes: Generated by `node scripts/export-ide.mjs codex`: AGENTS.md section + skills. Exported but never run inside Codex CLI as an interactive agent; see docs/ide/smoke-test.md.

cli_adapter.notes: `scripts/codex-review.mjs` runs `codex exec review` for an advisory, read-only review (scripts/lib/codex-adapter.mjs). Covered by tests/unit/codex-adapter.test.mjs and tests/unit/codex-review.test.mjs. Not a Claude subagent; the resulting review never counts toward the required-review gate unless a task explicitly opts in.

full_integration.notes: The CLI adapter is review-only; there is no task-state or handoff wiring for Codex.

static_export.notes: Generated by `node scripts/export-ide.mjs copilot`: custom agents, prompt files, instructions. Exported but never run inside Copilot; see docs/ide/smoke-test.md.

cli_adapter.notes: No headless task-running CLI for Copilot is used by this framework.

full_integration.notes: No task-state, handoff or review wiring exists for Copilot.

static_export.notes: Generated by `node scripts/export-ide.mjs opencode`, reusing the AGENTS.md + .agents/skills/ convention it shares with Codex. Exported but never run inside OpenCode; see docs/ide/smoke-test.md.

cli_adapter.notes: Not implemented; no verified CLI task-run convention for OpenCode yet.

full_integration.notes: No task-state, handoff or review wiring exists for OpenCode.

static_export.notes: No verified instructions/skills convention for this tool was found in this repository's research; not implemented, to avoid a false compatibility claim.
